paragraphs: Subject: Skating trip on Saturday. Dear parents of the Explorers, I hope that you are well. This month, our trip is on Saturday morning at the town sports center. The children will go skating with Coach Matt and me. This email gives you the plan and three things to do. The children are very happy about the trip. Lily and Leo ask me about skating every day.

First, the children meet at the school gate at half past eight. Then the bus leaves at a quarter to nine. Please come on time, because the bus cannot wait for late children. We arrive at the sports center at nine o'clock. The skating lesson is from half past nine to eleven o'clock. After the lesson, the children eat lunch at the center. The bus returns to the school at one o'clock. The sports center has a wide floor and a small kitchen. Parents are welcome to watch from the hall.

The first thing to do is to help your child with vocabulary. Each child must learn at least ten words about skating. Examples are "wheel," "helmet," and "balance." You can download the word list from the school site. If you have no printer at home, please reply to this email. I will print the list on the school printer. Coach Matt speaks English in the lesson, so the words will help your child. Please say the words with your child at home. I will give the children a short test on Thursday.

The second thing to do is to sign the trip note. Please deliver the note to school by Thursday. Please write your phone number on the note. Your child can give it to me in the library. Please do not send the note by email, because I need the paper.

The third thing to do is to pack the right bag. Each child needs a bottle of water, two pairs of socks, and a small towel. Coach Matt will give every child a helmet and skates at the center. Children with long hair must tie it back. Please write the name of your child on the towel.

Do you have a question? Please reply to this email. Thank you for your help. The children will write about the trip for Explorers' Blog. I will tell you when the post is ready. Best wishes, Teacher Kim.
